turns.question: What share of non-cancelled order revenue between 17 August and 2 October 2026 came from orders that have no return at all, in percent?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: revenue (revenue_eur) cannot be split by whether an order was returned, and returns are measured only as counts (returns_count, returns_on_order_date) and partner return amounts (returns_eur), not as the revenue of returned orders, so I cannot give this percentage. The closest metrics are return_rate (share of orders returned), net_revenue_eur (revenue minus partner returns) and revenue_eur.
